alt: Same dad, two teenagers — and two VERY different sets of rules. 😂
desc: Sarah Elizabeth Hyde plays all three characters in this Chad Daniels comedy: for her 14-year-old daughter, a party means keeping her water bottle close and not running into the woods with four boys — but for her 18-year-old son, the same warning ends with him looking awesome.
title: Same dad, two teenagers — and two VERY different sets of rules. 😂
